Equipment:Condensate 
 Extraction Pump
 Multi Stages Vertical Centrifugal Pump
 VB 310 - 12
 Guinard KSB - France

This 
document outlines the major maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed 
every five years as indicated Y5 in the above titled block.

This pump transfers the condensate from the hot well of 
condenser to the heaters then to feed tank.

The first draft initiated by 
eng. Mohamed Abd El Azeem, tested by eng. Mohamed Fawzy Agwa at 06 July 2004, revised by EDEPC quality control eng Abouda Elbanna, accepted by general manager eng. Mohamed El Sarrag, 
approved by eng Moneer Mahmoud Al Wakeel; Damietta 3x135 MW power station head sector, and certified by eng. Aly Al Lethy: 
EDEPCo inspection and quality control head sector.
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.

items:
A work permit must be issued 
 and the qualified maintenance staff should be carry the
 Suitable safety category,

Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Isolate the CB of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.

Isolate the pump mechanically by closing suction and delivery 
 valves.
Be sure that the pump is completely drained.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, Filler.
Vibrometer, Dial indicator.
Rags, Grease.

sections.text: Check the vibration level of the pump and record it.
Check discharge, pressure and record them.

items: Check the vibration level of the pump and record it.
Check discharge, pressure and record them.
Check the alignment and record it.
Disconnect the motor
Unbolt the coupling between the motor and the pump.
Remove the motor.
Dismantle every piping connecting to the pump.

Unbolt the pump from the barrel and take the unit and put it 
 on a clean stand.

Check the clearances of the pump before disassembly of the 
 pump.
Dismantle the thrust bearing.
Dismantle the packing seal.
Remove discharge elbow.
Carry out the first bearing (515).
Dismantle the first column pipe (107).

Dismantle the screwed coupling (466) by dismantle the two 
 shafts(403)&(404).Do not lose the locating pin (408),then remove the 
 shaft(403).
Carry out the second bearing (515).
Dismantle the pump with last stage of the impeller at first.

Remove the
 shaft sleeve (415).

Dismantle the fixations (1059) to 
 extract the last stage diffuser (101).

Unscrew the nut (4839) on a few 
 threads& hammer the nut slightly until unlocking the cone (483) to remove 
 impeller.

Draw out impeller fitted upon its 
 cone by sliding it on the shaft.

Unscrew stud bolts (5119), then 
 extract the suction casing (511).

Free the nut (218) and the 
 washers (217,219).
Draw out the key (440).
Draw the suction bowl (100B).
Then the shaft sleeve (418) is free now.
Remove the shaft (404).
Clean all parts of the pump.

Check the validity of the thrust 
 bearing.
Check all parts for any worn-out.
Check all parts for cracks.

Inspect the run-out of the 
 shafts.

Check the radial clearances for 
 the pump by measuring the gap between wearing rings of the diffusers and the 
 distance sleeves on the shaft and records them.
Clean all contact surfaces.

Mount the impellers and diffusers of the pump beginning from 
 the delivery side up to suction side as follow.
Fit the sleeve (418) on the shaft (404).

Cap the suction casing (100B) over the shaft with its bushing 
 (528) with tape (5282) and wear ring (310A).

Slide the tools sleeve (311A), this one will be thrust to the 
 bushing (528).

By using the nut (218), the first impeller (200B) fitted with 
 taper (483) will be thrust inside the stage diffuser (100A).
Assemble second bearing (515) fitted with its lining (5152).
Place the pin (408) on pump shaft.

Screw the shaft coupling (466) by assembly the two shafts 
 (403,404).
Place the pin (408) on pump shaft.
Assemble the column pipe (107).
Continue these operations up to last bearing (515).
Check the clearances of the pump.
Reassemble the delivery elbow (102).
Reassemble the stuffing box (600) and set new packing seal.
Assembly the thrust bearing.
Measure and adjust the clearance of the pump.
Connect every piping connecting to the pump.
Assemble the coupling between the motor and the pump.
Fix support motor with fixation (5019).

Adjust the alignment between the motor shaft and the pump 
 shaft and record it.

sections.text:
Before starting the pump, the following 
steps should be checked.

items:
Check the oil level in the 
 thrust bearing pump bath.

Open the cooling water for the 
 oil bath.

Open the suction and delivery 
 valves of the pump.

Check the direction of rotation 
 of the pump by pushing the electric button of the motor instantaneously.

Check the 
 temperature of the cooling 
 water and the anti-friction bearing.
Check for any water and oil leaks.

Measure the discharge and pressure of 
 the pump.

Check the vibration level and 
 record it.
